note: The RollerAds sweeps and lead offers on Geozo, US (owner, 19.11.2026: «На geozo ... есть usa трафик запустим там тоже все наши связки», «ставки минимально возможные на usa ставь по которым хоть какой то трафик пойдёт», «Все сделай»). One campaign, one group and 3 teasers per offer, a daily money limit on the campaign, minimum bid found by walking the ladder (a probe that is accepted IS the first real teaser). The settings (type, source, categories) are copied from the campaign that already works for the same kind of link (US 1537 LendingTree refi, 38206: commodity type 1, source 1 Websites). Geozo takes direct tracker links; the link is the tracker link of the offer on the custom domain of the buying team (eventsbytlcltd.com) with source_id=gz-[CAMPAIGN_ID]-[AD_ID]-[SITE_ID] (Geozo macros); no click id macro exists, the conversions are read on the RollerAds side by source_id. No TDS server: the tracker link is already a clean redirect to the offer, the same for everybody. Titles are 30..65 characters; the words are the words of the landings (the owner says Geozo takes aggressive creatives: the amounts are in, the invented stories, earnings and balance screenshots are not).
limits_note: Geozo refuses a campaign limit below $20 (15 answers validation.min.numeric, 20 is accepted, checked 19.11 on an empty campaign): the hard caps are daily $20 and total $20 (the campaign stops for good at $20 spent). The softer rule of the owner, $3 a day a campaign, is kept by `gz_sweeps.py --guard` (stops the ads of a campaign that spent $3 today, starts them again the next UTC day; stops everything when the balance falls below balance_floor_usd, the balance is shared with the other campaigns of the account).
